card.name: Linking words before materials or agents
card.fires_on: Small linking words (with, to, or, other) or a descriptor like 'charged' that come right before a named material, drug class or agent, such as membranes, contrast agents, or plastics, in hypersensitivity and compatibility statements.

modes.label: Reaction to an agent
modes.description: 'to' after reaction or hypersensitivity, before a named contrast agent or drug.
modes.example: MultiHance is contraindicated in patients with known allergic or hypersensitivity reactions<< to>> gadolinium-based contrast agents.

modes.label: Dialyzed with membranes
modes.example: Anaphylactoid reactions have been reported in patients dialyzed<< with>> high-flux membranes and treated concom

modes.label: Material or product lists
modes.description: 'or', 'other' or 'charged' inside lists of materials or products.
modes.example: Only use infusion bags made of polyvinyl chloride (PVC)<< or>> polyolefin (PO) such as
